answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the signal of a task receipt, and the cedar is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The whisper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
